title: MERRY: Semantically Decoupled Evaluation of Multimodal Emotional and Role Consistencies of Role-Playing Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the precision and recall of predicted emotional categories across multimodal outputs to identify an over-representation of positive emotions (e.g., happiness, gratefulness) and a deficiency in expressing neutral or fine-grained negative emotions, often stemming from RLHF.
